meta.title: Murderers VS Sheriffs Duel Modes

sources.label: Official Pro Servers Pass product info

sourceNotes: Rows cover stable player-facing queues and places for universe 7219654364 only.
4v4 is mentioned in the official universe tags, but no active exact-universe 4v4 queue or child place was verified for this dataset.
Pro Servers is included as an official player-facing place with an official access pass. No reward, matchmaking, or difficulty difference is asserted.
No clean queue/sign screenshots were captured, so image fields are intentionally omitted.

items.name: 1v1
items.bestFor: Solo aim practice and round timing
items.difficulty: Cleanest practice because teammate noise is removed
items.rewardNotes: No verified mode-specific reward difference found
items.partyFriendSupport: Best for solo play or dueling one friend
items.notes: Pick 1v1 when you want quick feedback on aim, dodging, and role timing.
items.verificationNote: Official places API returned place ID 124848751642883 with name [DUELS] 1v1.

items.name: 2v2
items.bestFor: Playing with one friend and learning trades
items.difficulty: More coordination than 1v1, but still readable
items.rewardNotes: No verified mode-specific reward difference found
items.notes: Pick 2v2 when you want teammate pressure without the round becoming too crowded.
items.verificationNote: Official places API returned place ID 92876937625630 with name [DUELS] 2v2.

items.name: 3v3
items.bestFor: Small team fights and crossfire practice
items.difficulty: Crowded enough that positioning and target choice matter more
items.rewardNotes: No verified mode-specific reward difference found
items.partyFriendSupport: Best when you have multiple friends or want busier rounds
items.notes: Pick 3v3 after you understand 1v1 timing and want to practice spacing around teammates.
items.verificationNote: Official places API returned place ID 101617670515690 with name [DUELS] 3v3.
